# Spec Kit managed integration artifacts

- These paths may be managed/generated by Spec Kit integration, extension, preset, hook, or event lifecycle commands.
- Before editing one directly, identify its authoritative source and whether `specify integration`, `specify extension`, `specify preset`, or another native lifecycle command should perform the change.
- Never manually change `.specify/integration.json` just to make an agent appear installed/default. Use native integration lifecycle commands so manifests and generated artifacts stay coherent.
- Installing an additional integration does not change `default_integration`.
- Enabled extensions/presets are registered for the active/default integration. A non-default integration may exist without current PowerPack-generated skills; verify materialization rather than inferring it from `installed_integrations` alone.
- Do not hand-edit generated Copilot skills to customize PowerPack behavior. Prefer source extension/preset changes and re-registration/rescaffolding.
- Direct edits are acceptable only for an explicit test fixture, migration/repair task, or investigation of generated output, and should be identified as such.
